content.intro: In this lesson, you will study the map() and flatmap() operations with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A stream pipeline expresses transformations over a source. Intermediate operations are lazy, a terminal operation triggers processing, and a stream should not be reused after it is consumed. Apply that reasoning specifically to transforming elements and confirm the result with the example or a targeted test. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.
